are the labeling patterns in setosusin (1) obtained from (A) the A.

reaction performed in the presence of H2
18O. The dashed line in (A)

figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Reaction pathways and potential energy changes from IM1 to IM8 (path A). Energy changes at the M06-2X/6-31+G(d,p) level (in kcal
mol−1) are shown on the arrows. The seven-membered lactone A ring was omitted in the calculation processes but is shown here for easier
reference. See the Supporting Information for the atomic coordinates of the reaction intermediate and transition state structures obtained from the
calculations.
